title: Bounded witness search equivalence and logarithmic witness codes
claims: LogWitnessCodesInP and LogWitnessesInP establish membership in the exact reference P for verifiers with logarithmic witness codes or logarithmic witnesses on positive inputs. The decoder, when needed, is required to be polynomial time.

EqualityIffWitnessSearch proves an equivalence over the exact P and NP definitions. The P = NP hypothesis gives P membership for a verified prefix-extension language in NP, yielding witness selection by a clocked polynomial-time loop. Neither side of the equivalence is established unconditionally.
P_subset_NP is the exact P ⊆ NP inclusion over the pinned reference.
DecideFromWitnessSearch constructs a polynomial-time decider from a bounded witness selector and a polynomial-time verifier. The decider checks the length bound as well as the verifier answer.
CollapseFromWitnessSearch derives NP ⊆ P under a universal bounded-witness selection hypothesis. The hypothesis is open.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
